title: The Apology — Sc146: Darwin bursts out of a locker — hop-in, face-off, make-up

source.github: mhvnsnt/cn-gigaleak-gumball, draft release untagged-1676e192ae8c72e95791, asset id 640772406
source.method: FLA (XFL zip) read via sequential local-header parser (2012 Flash zips have malformed central directory); DOMDocument.xml + LIBRARY symbol XMLs parsed directly. Same neutral per-keyframe transform format as production/dance-choreo v1: a part pose is (item, first_frame, affine matrix a/b/c/d/tx/ty, pivot). keyMode 9728 = pose-to-pose; sampled_frames hold each keyframe's elements to the next keyframe, matching SWF playback.

teaches: Entrance-and-confrontation staging on one locked photographic locker plate with no cuts and no background change: the scene opens on the empty lockers (f1), Gumball hops in from frame-right with his ankles strapped together (f12-22), a locker door pops open and Darwin emerges from inside the locker (f33), and the two play a complete arc — shock, a mutual shouting face-off (f43-65, both still hopping), then a calm make-up (f75-86). Separate GB and DWN scene layers carry the offset reactions, and the open locker door is the only piece of 'set' that ever moves.
notes: Gumball's ankles are strapped together for the whole scene — he enters hopping and even the angry face-off is played hopping in place; the constraint is the physical-comedy engine.
Darwin's entrance is from inside a locker: the door panel opens between f22 and f33 and stays open as a stage marker for the rest of the scene.
The background file is named GB215_Apology_SC146_LO_BG.jpg — a GB215 prefix inside a GB2215 episode file; production naming drift worth knowing when searching the archive.
The library carries a 'head_WITHOUT_Ears' face comp (363 kf) — an earless Gumball head variant for poses where the ears would tangle.
Face comps hold 3,954 kf vs 1,160 body-puppet kf.
